title: Client walkthrough: Corner Cup Café, VAT and Income Tax

scenes.action: Tax → VAT clients → Corner Cup Café
scenes.caption: Corner Cup Café: VAT-registered, quarterly
scenes.voice: Ellie Moss runs the Corner Cup Café. She's VAT-registered on the standard scheme and files quarterly.

scenes.action: Code your VAT: card takings, supplier invoices, wages (outside the scope)
scenes.caption: Every line gets a VAT code
scenes.voice: Card takings, food suppliers, utilities and wages. Every line gets a VAT code; wages are outside the scope of VAT.

scenes.action: A supplier line: VAT read from the receipt (“Read from the receipt”), Reclaimable
scenes.caption: Reclaimable VAT on purchases
scenes.voice: On purchases, the reclaimable VAT is recorded, using the receipt where there is one.

scenes.action: Still to code: 5 lines; the AI suggests codes; a person confirms
scenes.caption: Five lines for a person
scenes.voice: Five lines need a person. The AI suggests a code; Ade confirms or changes it.

scenes.action: Your VAT return panel: Sales (net), Purchases (net), VAT on sales, VAT on purchases, You owe HMRC
scenes.caption: Nine boxes, never by the AI
scenes.voice: The return is worked out by a rules engine from the coded lines. Never by the AI.

target.text: Worked out from your coded lines — never by the AI.

scenes.action: File with HMRC (sandbox); penalty points shown as none
scenes.caption: Filed (HMRC sandbox)
scenes.voice: Ade files the quarter. In this demo, that's HMRC's sandbox. HMRC's penalty points for the business show here too.

scenes.action: Filing requests → Corner Cup Café: Income Tax side in progress
scenes.caption: Income Tax: in progress
scenes.voice: On the Income Tax side, the café's figures are still being reviewed. Same lines, same sorting.
